title: Combo with included chips and drink — no duplicate charge for included components
notes: Regression for the BO-000004 production bug: a combo's included chips and drink were charged a second time as standalone cart lines even though they are already bundled into the combo's own price. This fixture pins the HAPPY PATH where the chosen included-drink name (Coca-Cola) does not collide with the exact name of any standalone catalog item (SA_MENU's standalone sodas are 'Coca-Cola (330ml)'/'Coca-Cola (500ml)', not a bare 'Coca-Cola') — the deterministic matcher correctly returns one line. It deliberately does NOT cover the case where the chosen drink name exactly collides with a standalone item's name (e.g. 'Sprite') — that is a second, distinct, confirmed-still-open bug in the deterministic extractor itself, pinned separately in tests/test_bo_000004_combo_hallucination.py::test_option_value_colliding_with_standalone_item_name_is_not_double_added. See conv_323 for the companion case proving a genuinely separate paid side is correctly kept as its own line.

turns.message: I'll have the Smash Burger Combo with Coca-Cola
